verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of a BigCommerce point-of-sale capability that shares catalog, inventory, or customers with the online store. The 'Omnichannel Ecommerce Software Solution' page appears only as a title with no POS content. The app marketplace and the management APIs are third-party or developer building blocks, not the product's own POS, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can sell in person with a point-of-sale that shares the same catalog, inventory, and customers as my online store
